Shanghainese

Everything is scraped from Wiktionary. Click to scroll to the bottom.

  1. 脫了
    • Used to indicate the occurrence of an action that results in a loss, vanishment or a negative outcome.
      腦子壞脫了／脑子坏脱了 [Shanghainese]  ―  6nau-tsy 6wa-theq-leq [Wugniu]  ―  Brain's busted
      太陽撥雲遮脫了。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      太阳拨云遮脱了。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      5tha-yan 7peq 6yun 1tso-theq-leq [Wugniu]
      The sun was hidden by the clouds.
    • 搿物事摜脫！ [Shanghainese, trad.]
      搿物事掼脱！ [Shanghainese, simp.]
      8geq 8meq-zy 6gue-theq [Wugniu]
      Throw that thing away!
    • 夜飯吃好了。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      夜饭吃好了。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      6ya-ve 7chiq-hau-leq [Wugniu]
      [The speaker has] finished dinner.
    • 吃好夜飯看電視。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      吃好夜饭看电视。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      7chiq-hau 6ya-ve 5khoe 6di-zy [Wugniu]
      After eating dinner, watch the television. (non-temporal)
    • 吃了交關物事 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      吃了交关物事 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      7chiq-leq 1ciau-kue 8meq-zy [Wugniu]
      Ate a lot of things
    • 手機落脫了。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      手机落脱了。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      5seu-ci 8loq-theq-leq [Wugniu]
      My phone is gone.
    • 衣裳汏脫伊再去汏浴。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      衣裳汏脱伊再去汏浴。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      1i-zaon 6da-theq-yi 1tse-chi 6da-yoq [Wugniu]
      Get the clothes washed before taking a shower.
    • 衣裳汏了伊再去汏浴。 [Shanghainese, trad. and simp.]
    • 手機末手機落脫，鑰匙末鑰匙勿帶，儂哪能介馬虎個啦？ [Shanghainese, trad.]
      手机末手机落脱，钥匙末钥匙勿带，侬哪能介马虎个啦？ [Shanghainese, simp.]
      5seu-ci-meq 5seu-ci 8loq-theq 8yaq-zy-meq 8yaq-sy 8veq-ta 6non 6na-nen 1ka 1ma-hu-gheq 0la [Wugniu]
      Your phone you lose, your keys you don't have, how can you be this careless?
    • 媽媽，我今朝去外婆屋裏吃了交關好物事！ [Shanghainese, trad.]
      妈妈，我今朝去外婆屋里吃了交关好物事！ [Shanghainese, simp.]
      1ma-ma 6ngu 1cin-tsau-chi 6nga-bu 7oq-li 7chiq-leq 1ciau-kue 5hau-meq-zy [Wugniu]
      Mum, I ate so much good stuff at grandma's house today! (Neutrally reporting having eaten)
    • 今朝一隻小鬼又來了，吃脫交關物事。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      今朝一只小鬼又来了，吃脱交关物事。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      1cin-tsau 7iq-tsaq 5shiau-ciu 6yeu 6le-leq 7chiq-theq 1ciau-kue 8meq-zy [Wugniu]
      The kid's come again today and ate a lot of things. (The speaker insinuates having "lost" something with 脫, without presenting this as a newly occurred state - the things had already been eaten for a while)
    • 物事儕撥伊吃脫了。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      物事侪拨伊吃脱了。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      8meq-zy 6ze 7peq-yi 7chiq-theq-leq [Wugniu]
      He's eaten everything. (The things have been "lost" to the eating, and is newly lost compared to before when the food was not eaten.)
  2. 咾
    • and; or; connector in lists
      飯咾麵咾吃個物事儕撥伊吃脫了。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      饭咾面咾吃个物事侪拨伊吃脱了。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      6ve-lau 6mi-lau 7chiq-gheq8-meq8-zy6 6ze 7peq 6yi 7chiq-theq7-leq [Wugniu]
      All the food was eaten by him, be it rice or noodles.
      • 2007, 钱乃荣 [Qian Nairong], 上海话大词典 [Shànghǎihuà dàcídiǎn], 上海辞书出版社, page 474:
        河裡個水齷齪咾少。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
        河里个水龌龊咾少。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
        6wu-li6-gheq 5sy 7oq-tsoq7-lau 5sau [Wugniu]
        The water in the river is dirty and hard to come by.
    • and; or; connector in lists
      飯咾麵咾吃個物事儕撥伊吃脫了。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      饭咾面咾吃个物事侪拨伊吃脱了。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      6ve-lau 6mi-lau 7chiq-gheq8-meq8-zy6 6ze 7peq 6yi 7chiq-theq7-leq [Wugniu]
      All the food was eaten by him, be it rice or noodles.
      • 2007, 钱乃荣 [Qian Nairong], 上海话大词典 [Shànghǎihuà dàcídiǎn], 上海辞书出版社, page 474:
        河裡個水齷齪咾少。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
        河里个水龌龊咾少。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
        6wu-li6-gheq 5sy 7oq-tsoq7-lau 5sau [Wugniu]
        The water in the river is dirty and hard to come by.
    • used to indicate subsequent actions in instructions
      豬肉要燒熟咾吃。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      猪肉要烧熟咾吃。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      1tsy-gnioq8 5iau 1sau-zoq8-lau 7chiq [Wugniu]
      You have to cook the pork thoroughly before eating.
    • and; or; connector for contrasting attributes
      我勿曉得伊好咾壞。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      我勿晓得伊好咾坏。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      6ngu 6veq8-shiau5-teq7 6yi 5hau-lau 6wa [Wugniu]
      I don't know if he's good or bad.
    • because; since; therefore
      我肚皮痛咾勿吃飯了。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      我肚皮痛咾勿吃饭了。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      6ngu 6du-bi6 5thon-lau 6veq8-chiq7 6ve leq [Wugniu]
      I'm not eating since my stomach hurts.
    • used to indicate the topic
      • 2007, 钱乃荣 [Qian Nairong], 上海话大词典 [Shànghǎihuà dàcídiǎn], 上海辞书出版社, page 474:
        人咾，今朝勿曉得明朝個。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
        人咾，今朝勿晓得明朝个。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
        6gnin-lau 1cin-tsau1 6veq8-shiau5-teq7 6min-tsau1-gheq [Wugniu]
        As for people, one doesn't know today how they will act tomorrow.
    • an intensifier
      就是搿能做咾！ [Shanghainese, trad. and simp.]
      6zhieu-zy6 8geq-nen6 5tsu-lau [Wugniu]
      Exactly this way!
    • a generic sentence-final particle
      我來咾，當心眼。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      我来咾，当心眼。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      6ngu 6le-lau 1taon-shin1-nge6 [Wugniu]
      I'm coming, watch out.
      吃飯咾！／我來咾！ [Shanghainese, trad.]
      吃饭咾！／我来咾！ [Shanghainese, simp.]
      7chiq 6ve lau 6ngu 6le lau [Wugniu]
      Time for dinner! / I'm coming!
    • a generic sentence-final particle
      我來咾，當心眼。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      我来咾，当心眼。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      6ngu 6le-lau 1taon-shin1-nge6 [Wugniu]
      I'm coming, watch out.
      吃飯咾！／我來咾！ [Shanghainese, trad.]
      吃饭咾！／我来咾！ [Shanghainese, simp.]
      7chiq 6ve lau 6ngu 6le lau [Wugniu]
      Time for dinner! / I'm coming!
  3. 屋裡
    • home; house; room
      有空阿拉屋裡白相來。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      有空阿拉屋里白相来。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      6yeu-khon 7aq-la 7oq-li 8beq-shian 6le [Wugniu]
      Come over to our home to play when you have time.
      地鐵站離我屋裡老近個。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      地铁站离我屋里老近个。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      6di-thiq-ze 6li 6ngu 7oq-li 6lau 6jin-gheq [Wugniu]
      The metro station is very close to my home.
    • home; house; room
      有空阿拉屋裡白相來。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      有空阿拉屋里白相来。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      6yeu-khon 7aq-la 7oq-li 8beq-shian 6le [Wugniu]
      Come over to our home to play when you have time.
      地鐵站離我屋裡老近個。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      地铁站离我屋里老近个。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      6di-thiq-ze 6li 6ngu 7oq-li 6lau 6jin-gheq [Wugniu]
      The metro station is very close to my home.
    • family
      阿拉屋裡有三個人。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      阿拉屋里有三个人。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      7aq-la 7oq-li 6yeu 1se-gheq 6gnin [Wugniu]
      My family has four people.
  4. 套牢
    • (Shanghainese) to be stuck in a loveless marriage
      • 2007, 钱乃荣 [Qian Nairong], 上海话大词典 [Shànghǎihuà dàcídiǎn], 上海辞书出版社, page 23:
        我勿當心買了個垃圾股，結婚以後原形畢露，現在苦了，套牢了！ [Shanghainese, trad.]
        我勿当心买了个垃圾股，结婚以后原形毕露，现在苦了，套牢了！ [Shanghainese, simp.]
        6ngu 8veq-taon-shin 6ma-leq-geq 6la-shi-ku 7ciq-huen 1i-gheu 6gnioe-yin 7piq-lu 6yi-ze 5khu-leq 5thau-lau-leq [Wugniu]
        I accidentally got a terrible spouse, after marriage, her true colours came to light, now it's genuinely difficult, I'm stuck!
    • (Shanghainese, by extension) to be stuck in any situation
      • 2007, 钱乃荣 [Qian Nairong], 上海话大词典 [Shànghǎihuà dàcídiǎn], 上海辞书出版社, page 23:
        我現在是撥我個小孫子套牢，天天上學要我接送。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
        我现在是拨我个小孙子套牢，天天上学要我接送。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
        6ngu 6yi-ze 6zy 7peq 6ngu 8geq 5shiau-sen-tsy 5thau-lau 1thi-thi 6zaon-ghoq 5iau 6ngu 7ciq-son [Wugniu]
        I've gotten into a predicament with my grandson, now I need to pick him up and send him to from school every day.
    • (Shanghainese) to be head over heels in love with someone
      • 2007, 钱乃荣 [Qian Nairong], 上海话大词典 [Shànghǎihuà dàcídiǎn], 上海辞书出版社, page 23:
        我自家撥自家個感情套牢，再也撥勿出來了。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
        我自家拨自家个感情套牢，再也拨勿出来了。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
        6ngu 6zy-ka 7peq 6zy-ga 8geq 5koe-zhin 5thau-lau 1tse 6gha 7peq-veq-tsheq-le 8leq [Wugniu]
        I am seriously in love, I won't be getting out of this.
    • (Shanghainese) to shut up
      • 2007, 钱乃荣 [Qian Nairong], 上海话大词典 [Shànghǎihuà dàcídiǎn], 上海辞书出版社, page 23:
        好了，阿拉儕聽厭了，好套牢了。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
        好了，阿拉侪听厌了，好套牢了。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
        5hau-leq 7aq-la 6ze 1thin-i-leq 5hau 5thau-lau-leq [Wugniu]
        Dude, we're all done with hearing your rambling, you better shut up.
  5. 唻
    • Used like an emphatic 了.
      • 2007, 钱乃荣 [Qian Nairong], 上海话大词典 [Shànghǎihuà dàcídiǎn], 上海辞书出版社, page 309:
        還有一樁猜勿出個事體唻。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
        还有一桩猜勿出个事体𫪁。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
        6we-yeu 7iq-tsaon 5tshoe-veq-tsheq-gheq 6zy-thi 0le [Wugniu]
        There's still one thing I can't guess.
    • Sentence-final particle expressing a monishing tone.
      • 2007, 钱乃荣 [Qian Nairong], 上海话大词典 [Shànghǎihuà dàcídiǎn], 上海辞书出版社, page 309:
        儂可以回去唻！ [Shanghainese, trad.]
        侬可以回去𫪁！ [Shanghainese, simp.]
        6non 5khu-i 6we-chi 0le [Wugniu]
        You can come back now!
    • Sentence-final particle expressing disapproval.
      • 2007, 钱乃荣 [Qian Nairong], 上海话大词典 [Shànghǎihuà dàcídiǎn], 上海辞书出版社, page 309:
        真也勿清白唻！ [Shanghainese, trad.]
        真也勿清白𫪁！ [Shanghainese, simp.]
        1tsen 6gha 8veq-chin-baq 0le [Wugniu]
        That doesn't help clear it up at all!
    • Sentence-final particle expressing envy or blame.
      • 2007, 钱乃荣 [Qian Nairong], 上海话大词典 [Shànghǎihuà dàcídiǎn], 上海辞书出版社, page 309:
        儂屋裏三房兩廳唻！ [Shanghainese, trad.]
        侬屋里三房两厅𫪁！ [Shanghainese, simp.]
        6non 7oq-li 1se-faon 6lian-thin 0le [Wugniu]
        Your place has five rooms and two are huge!
    • Sentence-final particle used to indicate an imperative.
      • 2007, 钱乃荣 [Qian Nairong], 上海话大词典 [Shànghǎihuà dàcídiǎn], 上海辞书出版社, page 309:
        算唻，勿要搭伊去爭唻。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
        算𫪁，勿要搭伊去争𫪁。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
        5soe-le 8veq-iau 7taq 6yi 5chi 1tsan-le [Wugniu]
        Give up, there's no point in fighting for it with him.

        侬哪能介糊涂啦！ [Shanghainese, simp.]

        覅提我搿個兒子，我都爲伊急死了，伊倒篤定泰山，老是講垃拉盤整，垃拉盤整。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
        覅提我搿个儿子，我都为伊急死了，伊倒笃定泰山，老是讲垃拉盘整，垃拉盘整。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
        6viau 6di 6ngu 8geq-geq 6gni-tsy 6ngu 1tu 6we 6yi 7ciq-shi-leq 6yi 5tau 7toq-din 5tha-se 6lau 6zy 5kaon 8laq-la 6boe-tsen 8laq-la 6boe-tsen [Wugniu]
        Don't mention my son, I'm already worried sick for him, yet he's still calm as cucumber, always on about being romantically stable, being romantically stable.
  10. 清爽
    • (dialectal Mandarin, Wu) clean
      儂房間老清爽個。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      侬房间老清爽个。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      6non 6vaon-ke1 6lau 1chin-saon5-gheq [Wugniu]
      Your room is very clean.
    • (Wu) clear
      我聽勿清爽伊垃該講啥。 [Shanghainese, trad.]
      我听勿清爽伊垃该讲啥。 [Shanghainese, simp.]
      6ngu 1thin-veq8 1chin-saon5 6yi 8laq-ke1 5kaon 5sa [Wugniu]
